switch.label: Daily routine
switch.description: Opens the shutters in the morning and closes them in the evening. While it is switched off, the daily routine moves nothing; protection keeps running.

general.title: Daily routine
general.description: How far the shutters open and close, how workdays, weekends and public holidays are told apart, and what else can begin the evening. The times follow on the next pages, one page per kind of day.

workday.title: Daily routine on workdays
workday.description: When the morning and the evening begin on a workday.

weekend.title: Daily routine on weekends
weekend.description: When the morning and the evening begin on a Saturday or Sunday, or on a day that the workday entity reports as free.

holiday.title: Daily routine on public holidays
holiday.description: When the morning and the evening begin on a day that the holiday entity reports as a public holiday.

schedule_morning_position.label: Morning position
schedule_morning_position.description: Where the shutter goes in the morning. 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. The morning only raises: a shutter that is already higher stays where it is.

schedule_evening_position.label: Evening position
schedule_evening_position.description: Where the shutter goes in the evening. 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. The evening only lowers: a shutter that is already lower stays where it is.

schedule_evening_position_summer.label: Evening position in summer
schedule_evening_position_summer.description: Replaces the evening position while it is summer, for example 30 % for privacy with some air. It counts only with a summer entity or with summer by date.

schedule_workday_source.label: Workday entity
schedule_workday_source.description: An entity that is on on workdays, for example the workday sensor of Home Assistant. With "None", Monday to Friday are workdays.

schedule_holiday_source.label: Holiday entity
schedule_holiday_source.description: An entity that is on on public holidays; a calendar with an all-day event works too. With "None" there are no public holidays.

schedule_season_source.label: Summer entity
schedule_season_source.description: An entity that is on while it is summer. While it has no value, its last known value counts.

schedule_summer_by_date.label: Summer by date
schedule_summer_by_date.description: Without a summer entity, summer lasts from the first to the last day given below.

schedule_summer_first_day.label: First day of summer
schedule_summer_first_day.description: Month and day with two digits each, for example 05-01 for 1 May.

schedule_summer_last_day.label: Last day of summer
schedule_summer_last_day.description: Month and day with two digits each, for example 09-30 for 30 September. The range may run across the turn of the year.

schedule_brightness_source.label: Outdoor brightness entity
schedule_brightness_source.description: An entity that reports the outdoor brightness in lux. When it has been darker than the threshold for the delay, the evening begins early, but never before "not before" of the evening. An entity without a value begins nothing and blocks nothing.

schedule_brightness_threshold_lux.label: Brightness threshold (lux)
schedule_brightness_threshold_lux.description: Below this outdoor brightness, in lux, it counts as dark.

schedule_brightness_delay.label: Brightness delay
schedule_brightness_delay.description: For how many minutes it has to be dark before the evening begins.

schedule_random_offset.label: Random offset
schedule_random_offset.description: Moves every trigger by up to this many minutes, earlier or later, differently for each window and day. 0 switches it off; 30 is the maximum.

kind.label: [edge]: trigger
kind.description: A fixed time; sunrise in the morning or sunset in the evening, with an offset; or the elevation of the sun. For the two that follow the sun, "not before" and "not after" under the expert values limit the time.

offset_minutes.label: [edge]: offset to sunrise or sunset
offset_minutes.description: Counts with the trigger "Sunrise or sunset". Minutes; a negative number means earlier.

elevation.label: [edge]: elevation of the sun
elevation.description: Counts with the trigger "Elevation of the sun". Degrees above the horizon; a negative number means below it.

not_before.label: [edge]: not before
not_before.description: The earliest time for a trigger that follows the sun. On a day on which the sun gives no time, this time or "not after" stands in.

not_after.label: [edge]: not after
not_after.description: The latest time for a trigger that follows the sun.
